subject.title: fix(agent): treat Anthropic long-context usage errors as context overflow for compact+retry

question: Should this PR be required to implement the compaction-then-fallback terminal outcome before merge, or may it land as classifier-only while the generic fallback design remains in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9986?
rationale: Both choices affect provider routing, auth/fallback behavior, and session compaction semantics, and the assigned maintainer review has already requested a broader terminal-state shape that the latest PR head still does not implement.

options.title: Require terminal fallback before merge
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until it compacts first and then emits a replay-safe failoverable terminal outcome after recovery is exhausted.

options.title: Accept classifier-only scope
options.body: Allow this PR to land with blocked-after-compaction semantics and leave generic overflow fallback to the open canonical issue.

options.title: Pause for broader design
options.body: Close or pause this PR and resolve the generic overflow fallback policy before changing this provider-specific classifier.

recommendation.title: Require terminal fallback before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until it compacts first and then emits a replay-safe failoverable terminal outcome after recovery is exhausted.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned and has already provided the item-specific maintainer review defining the desired fallback contract.
